title: Rolling Sea
line: Every wave is the same wave, arriving.
idea: Starts whole: a two-block ukiyo-e print of five wave bands rolling in parallax under a vermilion sun and a far snow peak, a boat of rowers riding the middle swell.
loop: Each band travels exactly one pattern length; the boat pitches over the swell as the crew pulls.
poster: Inside the loop: the boat on the rise of a swell.
alt: Sketch in woodblock-print style: bands of curling indigo waves with foam beads roll to the right under a red sun and a snow-capped peak, and a boat of rowers rides the swell.

title: Bamboo Wind
line: You only see the wind by what it bends.
idea: Starts whole: a sumi-e grove on rice paper where the wind is the only actor; gusts bend the culms, shiver the leaves and tear a few loose.
loop: Two gusts and the restless breeze between them; leaves tumble across and dry-brush streaks of wind pass.
poster: Inside the loop: the grove leaning into a gust.
alt: Sketch in sumi ink: black and grey bamboo stalks with clusters of brush-stroke leaves bend and sway in gusts of wind on cream rice paper, with a red seal in the corner.

title: Orrery
line: Draw the heavens carefully enough and they start to turn.
idea: Draws on: a blueprint is drafted (compass-swung orbits, column, arms, planets, gear train, dimensions), then the machine accelerates from rest into steady motion.
loop: Planets turn four, three, two and one times, the gears once, twice and three times, with pencil-yellow trails behind the planets.
poster: Inside the loop: the orrery running, trails behind each planet.
alt: Sketch of a blueprint: a planetary orrery drawn in white lines on blue grid paper, with orbit ellipses, a yellow sun, planets on arms, a gear train and dimension lines; the planets and gears turn.

title: Night City
line: Every lit window is somebody still awake.
idea: Starts whole: a three-ink riso poster of a city under a big moon; windows switch on and off, a lit train crosses the elevated line and the river repeats it all upside down.
loop: The train makes one lap, clouds drift one lap, a few windows go dark and come back, the mast light blinks.
poster: Inside the loop: the train crossing in front of the towers.
alt: Sketch in risograph style: a blue and pink city skyline with yellow lit windows under a big yellow moon, a pink train crossing on an elevated line, and the city reflected in the river below.

title: Fiddlehead
line: It was holding all of this, rolled up small.
idea: Grows: on a brushed cyanotype, a fern crozier unrolls into a full frond as a pale photogram shadow, its leaflets opening behind the uncurling tip.
loop: The frond breathes in a draught; a band of sunlight passes over the print with dust turning in it.
poster: Inside the loop: the frond fully open beside a younger crozier.
alt: Sketch of a cyanotype sun print: on a brushed field of Prussian blue, a pale fern fiddlehead unrolls into a tall frond beside grass stems and a small curled crozier.

title: Murmuration
line: Thousands of birds, and not one of them is in charge.
idea: Starts whole: dusk over a reed bed, every tone a density of dots, and a flock of starlings, one dot a bird, pouring itself through shapes.
loop: The flock stretches, folds, throws off a wing that returns, with waves of density running through it; three stragglers flap to catch up.
poster: Inside the loop: the flock folded into a long curve above the low sun.
alt: Sketch in stipple: a dusk sky over reeds made of ink dots, with a rose-coloured low sun, and a vast flock of starlings shown as dots that flows into changing shapes.

title: Lamplight
line: Everything on the table leans away from the light.
idea: Starts whole: an etched still life of a jug, two pears and a bowl under a hanging lamp that swings; the cross-hatched tone of the room and every shadow follow the light.
loop: Two swings of the lamp; cast shadows swing the other way, dark sides turn, a moth circles the bulb three times.
poster: Inside the loop: the lamp at the top of its swing, shadows thrown long.
alt: Sketch in etching style: a jug, two pears and a bowl on a table under a hanging lamp; the lamp swings and the cross-hatched shadows and pool of warm light move with it.

title: Sea Chart
line: The route is only ever the wake behind you.
idea: Draws on: an old chart inks itself in, border, coastlines and their ripple lines, compass rose and rhumb lines, a sea serpent and a cartouche, while a small ship is already under way.
loop: One whole voyage around the islands, a dotted red wake fading behind the ship, the serpent's coils rising and sinking.
poster: Inside the loop: the ship between the islands, its wake trailing.
alt: Sketch of an antique sea chart in sepia ink on stained vellum: islands with ripple lines, a compass rose, a sea serpent, and a small ship sailing a dotted red route around the islands.

title: Rain Window
line: The city dissolves, and the room gets warmer.
idea: Starts whole: an evening window in watercolour and pen, the city beyond dissolved wet into wet; the rain does the moving.
loop: Drops gather and run down the panes in stops and starts, headlights slide by, the far lights breathe and steam rises from a cup.
poster: Inside the loop: drops mid-run, headlights in the street.
alt: Sketch in watercolour: a window at night between rose curtains, rain drops on the glass and blurred city lights beyond, with a potted plant and a steaming cup on the sill.

title: Snow Fox
line: Curled up small enough, the winter goes around you.
idea: Starts whole: a black and vermilion linocut of a fox asleep in the snow under pines and a ringed moon; snow shows only where it crosses the black and the red.
loop: Snow falls in three depths; the fox breathes four times, flicks an ear twice and its tail tip once.
poster: Inside the loop: the fox asleep, snow crossing the night.
alt: Sketch as a black, red and cream linocut: a red fox curled asleep in snow below carved pine trees and a full moon with halo rings, with snow falling.
